company.name: Magnitt
company.shortDescription: Magnitt is a startup directory that connects investors, mentors, and emerging companies in the Middle East.
company.description:
MAGNiTT is a venture capital data and analytics platform focused on the Middle East, Africa, Pakistan, and Turkey (MENAPT) region. The platform provides comprehensive market intelligence on startups, investors, venture funds, and capital activity, enabling data-driven decision-making across emerging venture ecosystems.

MAGNiTT serves venture capital firms, institutional investors, government entities, accelerators, corporates, and financial institutions by offering reliable and up-to-date insights into regional startup ecosystems and investment trends. Its extensive database includes information on funding rounds, investor activity, startup performance, sector growth, and market dynamics across multiple industries and investment stages.

The company operates through a subscription-based business model, granting clients access to a suite of analytics and intelligence products, including quarterly venture capital reports, benchmarking tools, market dashboards, and custom data solutions. These resources help organizations analyze capital flows, evaluate market opportunities, monitor ecosystem performance, and compare regional venture activity against global investment trends.
By combining structured venture data, research reports, and analytical tools, MAGNiTT enables stakeholders to identify emerging opportunities, track investment behavior, and develop informed investment and growth strategies within fast-evolving startup markets. Through its data-driven infrastructure, MAGNiTT has established itself as a key intelligence provider for the venture capital and innovation ecosystem across the MENAPT region.
